title: Node2Shell: Brotli Flaw Triggers Patching Across Microsoft, Node.js, Python Packages
description: CVE-2026-111497, dubbed Node2Shell, is a critical out-of-bounds write vulnerability in Google’s Brotli decoder affecting versions 1.0.3 through 1.2.0. It impacts multiple platforms including Node.js, .NET, PowerShell, and Python packages, allowing unauthenticated attackers to cause memory corruption that can lead to process crashes, memory leaks, or arbitrary code execution. The flaw has been patched in Brotli versions 1.0.10, 1.1.1, and 1.2.1, with corresponding updates released by Microsoft, Node.js, and Python package maintainers. No exploitation in the wild has been reported, but proof-of-concept code demonstrates code execution on certain Linux arm64 Node.js builds. The vulnerability arises when attacker-controlled compressed data is processed by the affected Brotli decoder.
